caption: The drawing depicts a single bag with a drawstring closure at the top, rendered in a realistic style. The bag features an intricate, colorful pattern with floral and leaf motifs. The background of the main section of the bag is a cream or off-white color, decorated with large, detailed designs in green, red, light blue, and dark blue, as well as touches of pink and brown. The upper and lower edges of the bag are bordered by wide red bands; the upper band contains a repeating pattern of small blue flowers with white centers, while the lower band features a more densely packed pattern of red, blue, and white forms on a red background. The drawstring at the top appears to be brown or tan and is loosely tied, with the fabric at the opening gathered around it. There is a signature at the lower right corner of the drawing that reads "FLORIAN ROKITA." The background of the drawing itself is a plain, neutral beige.
title: Bag
